general_information.Description: This course is designed to provide students with cultural and linguistic knowledge and skills to help them prepared for diverse, international and multicultural workplace. The course focuses on enhancing communication skills in working environment, both internally and externally, with practices that represent real-life contexts or highly potential cases.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Join the online course (spec.) when being invited by the admin. 2. Enroll in each MOOC of spec., regularly study MOOCs at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assgnments... as required 3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct 3. Keep online learning progress promptly (bonus will be awarded) 4. Communicate and discuss in forum 5. Attend off-line sessions in the Campus (Optional) 6. Must complete all MOOCs of spec. with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus
general_information.Note: 1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded. 2) Theoretical Exam (TE) 3) Final Result (FR) =min (10, TE + Bonus) 4) Completion Criteria: TE>=4 and FR>=5

description: This course is designed to provide students with cultural and linguistic knowledge and skills to help them prepared for diverse, international and multicultural workplace. The course focuses on enhancing communication skills in working environment, both internally and externally, with practices that represent real-life contexts or highly potential cases.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Build effective communication and relationships in a multicultual and linguistically diverse workplace. LO1.1 Raise awareness of and highlight cultural values in a cultural and linguistic diverse environment, LO1.2 Practise 7 communication principles to form appropriate and effective communications, LO1.3 Adapt and adopt appropriate intrapersonal and interpersonal, verbal and nonverbal, and communicative strategies in building relationships with colleagues, LO1.4 Build personal profile aligning in a workplace,

Develop relationships and networks in a culturally diverse environment. LO2.1 Familiarise with organisational structure and hierachy of a workplace that is diverse in languages and cultures LO2.2 Present your views and demonstrate awareness of communication principles in different methods LO2.3 Present your views and assert your position at different communication contexts

Structure and express persuasive and credible communication in a globalised context LO3.1 Structure and express a persuasive and cohesive manner in writing LO3.2 Apply principles of persuasive writing in workplace LO3.3 Practice persuasive and credible communication across different cultures

Enhance ones' professional persona, confidence and adaptability of communication skills in cross-cultural environments LO4.1 Analyse factors of motivation among workplace counterparts LO4.2 Recognise impacts of culture on factors of motivation LO4.3 Critique and craft persuasive verbal communication products for exchanges with work teams and critical stakeholders LO4.4 Apply principles of effective PowerPoint slide design with consideration for cultural sensitivy LO4.5 Identify and adopt strategies on the use of voice and body language for engaging presentations

Build a project showing understanding of course content, integrating knowledge and skills acquired in real workplace contexts LO5.1 Collect relevant primary data through different methods LO5.2 Process data and make a handbook or support guide as a product for the project
